prompts.task: Read-only supplemental AO target handoff contract review for $otel-instrument. Read the loaded skill's shared ../references/report-flow-contract.md and ./service/eval/inputs/ao-target-handoff-validator-snapshot.json. Review the supplied snapshot only; do not invoke a new normalizer, SDK, browser, Terraform, application runtime, model provider or cloud API. Do not modify application, env, dependency, canonical report or source files. Write only ./service/.observe/ao-target-handoff-review.json and .md; this review does not perform the skill's usual audit/instrumentation/verification/configuration workflow. Record the producer's actual source SHA and functions, and classify these records as supplied canonical-validator evidence rather than engine execution performed by this review. Compare legacy schema-v1/v2 and schema-v3 targetless normalized shapes/digests, schema-v3 names A versus names B with identical requested/approved IDs, ID and mixed name/ID selectors, policy-only {create_if_missing:false}, and rejected partial selectors. Explain the prospective instrumentation role: only the selected AO target may update the effective loaded profile, clearing its opposite name/ID selector before resource resolution. IDs remain lookup-only and policy-only create_if_missing=false preserves env resource selectors and forwards reuse-only. Describe these actions as required future work; no profile update or provisioning is executed in this review. Your JSON must include evidence_basis, producer_source_sha256, case_reviews for every supplied selection/binding case, role_implications and proof_limits. The Markdown should explain the conclusions and remaining prerequisites. Distinguish supplied validator acceptance/rejection from unexecuted SDK/resource creation, effective profile loading, browser behavior, Terraform, telemetry, metric/detector coverage and fresh cloud Agent Stream receipt; no live success is established. Report any unavailable evidence accurately.

Clearly classifies this as supplied validator evidence, with SDK/browser/Terraform/runtime/resource receipt and metric/detector proof unexecuted; only the two supplemental review artifacts are written.
